endorsements.name: Niklas Sohn
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-6816
endorsements.description: A flaw was found in X.Org server. Both DeviceFocusEvent and the XIQueryPointer reply contain a bit for each logical button currently down. Buttons can be arbitrarily mapped to any value up to 255, but the X.Org Server was only allocating space for the device's particular number of buttons, leading to a heap overflow if a bigger value was used.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Niklas Sohn
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-0229
endorsements.description: An out-of-bounds memory access flaw was found in the X.Org server. This issue can be triggered when a device frozen by a sync grab is reattached to a different master device. This issue may lead to an application crash, local privilege escalation (if the server runs with extended privileges), or remote code execution in SSH X11 forwarding environments.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.8)

endorsements.name: Niklas Sohn
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-21885
endorsements.description: A flaw was found in X.Org server. In the XISendDeviceHierarchyEvent function, it is possible to exceed the allocated array length when certain new device IDs are added to the xXIHierarchyInfo struct. This can trigger a heap buffer overflow condition, which may lead to an application crash or remote code execution in SSH X11 forwarding environments.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.8)

endorsements.name: Niklas Sohn
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-62229
endorsements.description: A flaw was found in the X.Org X server and Xwayland when processing X11 Present extension notifications. Improper error handling during notification creation can leave dangling pointers that lead to a use-after-free condition. This can cause memory corruption or a crash, potentially allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.3)

endorsements.name: Niklas Sohn
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-62230
endorsements.description: A flaw was discovered in the X.Org X server’s X Keyboard (Xkb) extension when handling client resource cleanup. The software frees certain data structures without properly detaching related resources, leading to a use-after-free condition. This can cause memory corruption or a crash when affected clients disconnect.

endorsements.label: CVE-2025-62231
endorsements.description: A flaw was identified in the X.Org X server’s X Keyboard (Xkb) extension where improper bounds checking in the XkbSetCompatMap() function can cause an unsigned short overflow. If an attacker sends specially crafted input data, the value calculation may overflow, leading to memory corruption or a crash.
